20261103IN84785.description: Indiana Question 1. Allows courts to deny bail to defendants in certain circumstances.
20261103IN84785.summary: This proposed amendment to Indiana's constitution would allow courts to deny bail to criminal defendants when they pose a substantial risk to others, there is evident proof of an offense and conditional release would not keep others safe.

20261103IN84786.description: Indiana Question 2. Revises residency requirements for municipal judges.
20261103IN84786.summary: This proposed amendment to Indiana's constitution would allow municipal judges to live in the county in which the city or town court is located or in a bordering county that is closest to the municipality.
